name: THERA
source:
THERA is a collection of games.
THERA is a visual novel.
THERA is a nightmare I had once.
THERA isn't.
THERA is digitized spite.
THERA is text on your screen.
THERA is slated to be destroyed along with the Earth by the eventual expansion of the Sun.

[From [url=https://kyousystem.itch.io/thera]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
THERA是一个游戏合集。
THERA是一部视觉小说。
THERA是我曾经经历过的一场噩梦。
瑟拉不是。
THERA是数字化的恶意。
THERA是屏幕上的文本。
THERA预计将与地球一起因太阳的最终膨胀而被摧毁。

[来自[url=https://kyousystem.itch.io/thera]itch.io[/url]]
